Improved Wrath.text: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec.

Nature's Grasp.text: While active, any time an enemy strikes the caster they have a 35% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots (Rank 1). Only useable outdoors. 1 charge. Lasts 45 sec.

Improved Nature's Grasp.text: Increases the chance for your Nature's Grasp to entangle an enemy by 15%.

Improved Entangling Roots.text: Gives you a 40% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting Entangling Roots.

Improved Moonfire.text: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 2%.

Natural Weapons.text: Increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 2%.

Natural Shapeshifter.text: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.

Improved Thorns.text: Increases damage caused by your Thorns spell by 25%.

Nature's Reach.text: Increases the range of your Wrath, Entangling Roots, Faerie Fire, Moonfire, Starfire, and Hurricane spells by 10%.

Vengeance.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Starfire, Moonfire, and Wrath spells by 20%.

Improved Starfire.text: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.1 sec and has a 3% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

Nature's Grace.text: All spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, reducing the casting time of your next spell by 0.5 sec.

Moonglow.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Moonfire, Starfire, Wrath, Healing Touch, Regrowth and Rejuvenation spells by 3%.

Moonfury.text: Increases the damage done by your Starfire, Moonfire and Wrath spells by 2%.

Moonkin Form.text: Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form the armor contribution from items is increased by 360% and all party members within 30 yards have their spell critical chance increased by 3%. The Moonkin can on

Ferocity.text: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 1 Rage or Energy.

Feral Aggression.text: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 8% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 3%.

Feral Instinct.text: Increases threat caused in Bear and Dire Bear Form by 3% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling.

Brutal Impact.text: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 0.5 sec.

Thick Hide.text: Increases your Armor contribution from items by 2%.

Feline Swiftness.text: Increases your movement speed by 15% while outdoors in Cat Form and increases your chance to dodge while in Cat Form by 2%.

Feral Charge.text: Causes you to charge an enemy, immobilizing and interrupting any spell being cast for 4 sec.

Sharpened Claws.text: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear, Dire Bear or Cat Form by 2%.

Improved Shred.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6.

Predatory Strikes.text: Increases your melee attack power in Cat, Bear and Dire Bear Forms by 50% of your level.

Blood Frenzy.text: Your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points have a 50% chance to add an additional combo point.

Primal Fury.text: Gives you a 50% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear and Dire Bear Form.

Savage Fury.text: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Maul and Swipe abilities by 10%.

Faerie Fire (Feral).text: Decrease the armor of the target by 175 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

Heart of the Wild.text: Increases your Intellect by 4%. In addition, while in Bear or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 4% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 4%.

Leader of the Pack.text: While in Cat, Bear or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases ranged and melee critical chance of all party members within 45 yards by 3%.

Improved Mark of the Wild.text: Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 7%.

Furor.text: Gives you 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear and Dire Bear Form or 40 Energy when you shapeshift into Cat Form.

Improved Healing Touch.text: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0.1 sec.

Nature's Focus.text: Gives you a 14% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting the Healing Touch, Regrowth and Tranquility spells.

Improved Enrage.text: The Enrage ability now instantly generates 5 Rage.

Reflection.text: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Insect Swarm.text: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 2% and causing 66 Nature damage over 12 sec.

Subtlety.text: Reduces the threat generated by your Healing spells by 4%.

Tranquil Spirit.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by 2%.

Improved Rejuvenation.text: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%.

Nature's Swiftness.text: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

Gift of Nature.text: Increases the effect of all healing spells by 2%.

Improved Tranquility.text: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by 50%.

Improved Regrowth.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by 10%.

Swiftmend.text: Consumes a Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect on a friendly target to instantly heal them an amount equal to 12 sec. of Rejuvenation or 18 sec. of Regrowth.
